name: marks
install: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && bash .cursor/harness/install.sh

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Runs the sync server (http://localhost:3000) and the Vite client dev server (http://localhost:5173) together. Open the client URL to use the app; it proxies /api and /collab to the server.

terminals.name: playwright
terminals.description: Hot Playwright Chrome (CDP http://127.0.0.1:9222) inside CGNAT namespace cg-playwright (subnet 100.64.10.0/24). Attach with playwright.chromium.connectOverCDP; run clients via: sudo ip netns exec cg-playwright runuser -u ubuntu -- <cmd>.

terminals.name: puppeteer
terminals.description: Hot Puppeteer Chrome (CDP http://127.0.0.1:9223) inside CGNAT namespace cg-puppeteer (subnet 100.64.20.0/24). Attach with puppeteer.connect({ browserURL }); run clients via: sudo ip netns exec cg-puppeteer runuser -u ubuntu -- <cmd>.

terminals.name: agent-browser
terminals.description: Hot agent-browser Chrome (CDP http://127.0.0.1:9224) inside CGNAT namespace cg-agent (subnet 100.64.30.0/24). Drive it in-namespace with a pinned HOME so its daemon stays co-located, e.g.: sudo ip netns exec cg-agent runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/home/ubuntu/.cache/harness/agent-home .cursor/harness/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser --cdp 9224 open example.com
